scope: Finish and saved-result validation require 36 selected device/implant records: 34 absence-only VPP, pwell-resistor and PNP subjects, 95 nm tunm enclosure of overlapping gates, and drawn hvntm containment in hvi. Mandatory drawn-purpose absence is checked alongside all reachable cell names and labels; present candidates remain unreviewed. Missing SONOS intent markers cannot establish absence. Eight source-published RR entries are advisory, never executed passes. All 115 focused tests pass per OS, 17 retained controls match exactly, and all three application runs plus Windows export replays pass. The original reference catalog has 405 executed, 568 absent, 90 W/L exemptions, 8 advisory and 485 unreviewed records. Corrected streams retain 166 explicit current catalog messages. Full required geometry, density and chip-context coverage remains incomplete.

cases.scope: Actual Runner export removes only the top-level prBoundary box matching the independent OpenDB die. Manufacturing masks and text are compared in full. Six partial geometry profiles, antenna, isolation, OpenDB checks and macro export rerun on the corrected GDS. Original timing/equivalence remains separate; no new extraction, full physical signoff or installer qualification. The retained 45-record core context is supplemented by 37 explicitly absent label, named-cell and raw-layer subjects; present subjects require further review. Four new VPP geometry checks execute, with absent capacitor targets on these references. Density observations do not establish density acceptance. Forty-four new module/seal interaction checks execute. Missing module or seal geometry does not establish complete-chip context. Thirty-six selected device requirements are measured: VPP, pwell resistor and PNP absence requires no drawn markers or candidate names/labels; two implant geometry checks execute with absent targets in these references. Earlier full catalog results retain their original GDS identities.

boundary_export.scope: Remove only the single top-level prBoundary box equal to the OpenDB die, if present. All other forbidden boundary-purpose input is rejected; manufacturing shapes and annotations are preserved.

selected_devices.scope: Thirty-four VPP, pwell-resistor and PNP catalog records are absent only when their mandatory drawn purpose has no raw shapes and no reachable cell name or label suggests the device. Present candidates remain unreviewed. Separately, each gate (poly AND diff) overlapping tunm must be enclosed by tunm by 95 nm, and every drawn hvntm region must be inside hvi. Gates outside tunm are not selected by this enclosure check; their spacing and device intent remain separate. A SONOS name or label with no gate or with unselected gates keeps r453 unreviewed. Generated implants and complete device/density qualification are not established.

boundary_interactions.scope: Thirty-five published drawn-layer purposes are checked for straddling each supplied module-cut polygon on 81:10. Diffusion is checked for straddling seal 81:1; tap, poly, li1 and met1-met5 are checked for positive-area seal overlap. Targets are merged connected regions. Boundary polygons must be disjoint and non-touching so merging cannot hide an internal boundary. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths are supported. Missing boundary geometry does not establish chip/frame completeness or waive any enclosure or spacing requirement. Five package-layer scribe records remain separate.

catalog_context.scope: Thirty-three explicitly core-selected geometry messages and one core-approval message require absence of all raw areaid.ce data; three LDNTM messages require absence of the actual implant subject. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Eight boundary prohibitions are checked directly. This is not complete catalog coverage or memory-device qualification.

catalog_labels.scope: Thirty-seven literal catalog messages are resolved only by complete absence of their selected label, named-cell or raw-layer subject. Labels are searched on every purpose and through the hierarchy; case, Unicode compatibility, whitespace and embedded-token variants conservatively prevent absence. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Unmarked floating nets, redundant vias, chip part-number requirements and the construction of module/frame regions remain separate.

vpp_geometry.scope: Selected rules on merged capacitor drawing 82:64: 1.43 um minimum width, no straddling nwell or dnwell, and 1.5 um enclosure for capacitors overlapping nwell. An outside-nwell capacitor leaves the enclosure requirement unreviewed; missing nwell never proves exemption. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths. Density operands are measured per connected capacitor region without selecting device exceptions or claiming density acceptance. Other VPP rules remain separate.

limitations: Thirty-four family records claim absence only on these exact references, requiring empty mandatory drawn purposes and no device hints. Present VPP, pwell resistor or PNP candidates remain unreviewed.

Two implant checks are numerical: 95 nm enclosure of gates overlapping drawn tunm, and drawn hvntm inside hvi. Missing or incomplete SONOS marking with a name/label hint remains unreviewed. Full device intent and all implant rules are not qualified.
The eight RR records are pinned to explicitly recommended parent rules. They claim no numerical redundancy, crater or part-number execution, and do not waive any required rule.
Exact Manhattan geometry, orthogonal paths and unit orthogonal hierarchy are supported; unsupported geometry or units fail. Holes and partial overlaps cannot be hidden by bounding boxes.

Seventeen controls cover valid implants, 1 nm failures, holes, arrays, absent implant context, all three device markers and names without markers, and Unicode labels. Windows and Linux GDS/report bytes agree.
Missing or modified reports, failed implant checks and rehashed layouts carrying stale measurements fail current validation. Older saved reports require Finish rechecking.
Corrected streams retain 166 explicit current catalog messages, separate from the unchanged six-profile ledger. Full historical decisions remain tied to their original GDS identities.
Manufacturing geometry, checkpoints, netlists and SPEF are unchanged. This batch claims no new extraction, timing, full physical signoff or foundry acceptance.
Generated masks, RF selectors, grid semantics, frame/pad context, pin-spacing definitions and remaining required density/catalog coverage stay open.
